column3: The written Hebrew reads “Shimea”; NASB keeps it.
The Hebrew אַסִּר may be a name (“Assir”); NASB renders “the prisoner.”
The Hebrew “the son of Zerubbabel” is rendered “the sons of Zerubbabel.”
“The descendant of Hananiah” is rendered “the sons of Hananiah.” The Hebrew list is difficult.
“The sons of Shecaniah” is rendered “the son of Shecaniah”; the total “six” does not match the five names.
“The son of Neariah” is rendered “the sons of Neariah.”
